groups.sentence: Instructors may require students to disclose, cite or explain their AI use.
Administrators or unit policies set up disclosure requirements and frameworks for AI use.
Instructors tell students how to disclose, cite or acknowledge AI use.
Students properly cite or attribute AI-generated content or AI tools they use in their work.
Students disclose or acknowledge their AI use in submitted work and how they used it.
Everyone is transparent about their AI use and cites or discloses it.
Students include a statement explaining how and where they used AI, or document the process of use.
Students follow their instructor's or assignment's requirements for disclosing, documenting and citing AI use.
Students clearly mark which parts of their work are their own and which are AI generated.
Students do not submit AI-generated content or ideas without acknowledging or citing it.
Students may use AI if the use is properly documented and credited.
Students explain how they used AI when asked.
Transparency and citation of AI use are valued; norms and benefits are described, and minor uses may need no disclosure.
Community members do not hide or conceal their use of AI.
